system.description: Essence Training Package Spell List 14.1.10 - Mirror Magic. Spells to create, enrune, and scry through mirrors, steal and trap reflections, travel between linked mirrors, and enter the Mirror World.

Allows caster to magically create a mirror (up to 6'x6') from any appropriate glass object. Caster must concentrate for 3 rounds after this spell is cast for the mirror to form. At the end of the duration, the glass object will return to its normal form.
Target has no reflection in mirrors and other reflective objects. This can affect other spells on this list (Reflection Double, Reflect Inner Truth, and Mirror Slave).

Allows caster to levitate a flat mirror (no larger than 2'x2'). The mirror must remain in sight of the caster at all times. While the caster concentrates, the mirror can be maneuvered around a within range of the spell at a rate of 20' per round.

Allows caster to gaze into a reflective surface and gain knowledge regarding one specific topic. This information will be conveyed in an indirect, symbolic, and metaphorical manner. The caster is in a trance like state for the duration of his vision.

Prepares a mirror to receive a rune. A magical rune spell must be cast on the mirror within one minute after casting this spell, and then the spell to be enruned must be cast (as per normal rules for runes). The rune will be activated by someone looking in the mirror (if the spell has one target, the first person to look in the mirror becomes the target). Once the spell has been discharged, the rune fades. The caster will not trigger his own mirror runes.
Creates a 10'x10'x1" mirrored wall. This wall can take 50 concussion hits before shattering.

This spell may be cast on two mirrors that are within 1000' feet of each other (at the time of casting). The mirrors must have the spells cast upon them within 1 day. The mirrors must be at least 2'x3' in size. At any time during the duration of this spell, the caster may step 'into' one of the two mirrors and emerge 'out of' the other. If either mirror is moved, the spell is dispelled. Note that this spell must be cast separately on each mirror of a pair and only two mirrors at a time may hold this spell.
When cast on an appropriate reflective surface, the surface will reflect all objects, including those that are masked by magic.

Allows the caster to create an illusionary image in any shape or size (up to 10'x10' in size). The illusion is purely visual, but the caster may control the movement of objects in the image, or change the entire image by concentrating.
Allows caster to ask a single 'yes/no' question while gazing into a mirror. He will receive a correct answer 75% of the time, an incorrect answer 20% of the time and a detailed answer 5% of the time.

When cast on a mirror, this spell traps the gaze of the next person who looks into it and fails a RR. If trapped, the victim will stand or sit immobile, and continue to look unwaveringly into the mirror, paying absolutely no attention to any activity around him (target can initiate no actions). The mirror trance can be interrupted by breaking the victim's visual contact with the mirror. The caster is immune to his own Mirror Trance spells.

Pulls target's reflection from mirror, to become a doppelganger-like entity under control of the caster, as long as he concentrates. The reflection has the same skills and combat abilities as the target (though any wounds the target had at the time of casting will also appear on the double). If the target is a spell caster, the double will have the same number of PPs the target had at the time of the casting of this spell. For each wound the double takes, the target takes half as much damage (the concussion and half of all other penalties).
All mirrors in the radius shatter explosively. Victims within 50' of any mirrors, who are unable to make maneuver rolls to avoid the flying shards of glass take d10 'A' slash criticals.

If target fails his RR, anyone in his presence will see a representation of his 'true inner self' in reflective surfaces. For example, if the target is a blowhard bully who is really a coward, his reflection might depict him as a sheep.
As Mirror Question I, except answer may consist of a short phrase (no more than 10 words).
As Mirror Door I, except mirrors may be separated by up to 20 miles.

Traps target's soul in a mirror designated by the caster (the caster must be touching the mirror when the spell is cast), where he will remain until the mirror is shattered. If the mirror is broken, the target takes a 'B' impact critical as his soul escapes.

Allows caster to use a mirror to deflect his mirror that has just been cast on him. If the caster is touching his mirror, he can position it between himself and the attacking spell, and the caster of the attack spell becomes the victim of his own attack.
As Steal Reflection, except for duration.
As Mirror Door I, the mirrors may be up to 10 miles apart.

Caster causes a maze of mirrors to spring up and occupy an area of up to 50'x50' (there can be no intervening objects such as walls within the designated area). Mirrors are 10' high and can withstand 50 concussion hits per 5' section before shattering. The 'corridors' of the maze are 5' wide. Caster intuitively knows how to maneuver through his own maze.

As Reflection Double, except target's reflection becomes caster's personal slave, under his complete control. The target no longer has a reflection. The target's reflection can be restored by the caster or by the caster's death.

Allows caster to pass through a mirror, and enter the Mirror World. The Mirror World parallels the caster's 'real world' only at the point of connection (the mirror). Beyond sight of the mirror, the world will be completely different. He must return to his own world through the same mirror he left it. If he remains longer than the spell duration, there is a 1% cumulative chance per day that he will become permanently trapped in the Mirror World. Note that if the mirror in the caster's own world is moved or destroyed, he will be unable to return home until another mirror is placed in the same location as the previous one.
